# Clean the Bay

> Clean the Bay is a cozy cleaning and building game for PC (Windows, Steam) by Odd Bean Games, a small indie studio from Germany. You come home to a bay covered in oil and clean it field by field with a kayak and a sponge, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

## Facts

- Genre: cozy cleaning and building simulation
- Platform: PC (Windows) on Steam, Steam Deck support planned
- Players: 1 to 4, online co-op
- Playtime: about 25 to 30 hours to the finale
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
- Release: full release, no Early Access, date to be announced
- Demo: free demo at Steam Next Fest, February 22 to March 1, 2027
- Studio: Odd Bean Games, Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Germany

## What you do

- Wipe, scoop and skim oil. Every clean field pays out, every new tool cleans a wider strip, from a sponge to a coast guard boat.
- Fish return a day after you clean. Photograph 36 species for your logbook, from herring to orca.
- Bring full barrels home before they leak and ride out storms. Meet Grandma Greta, grumpy Captain Hinnerk and the other people of the bay.
- Letters signed "L." wash up in bottles. Collect them, find the five leaks and the evidence against the oil tycoon.
